_doc: Values of run XG (logs/XG.events.txt, logs/XG.RUN_INFO, logs/XG.time.txt, logs/XG.image.lst, logs/XG.noinstr.lst): simulation (simulate.sh) of a git archive of commit 524ca79 of branch platform-all (round r12: repo_state=archive, no tag) of weird_a with the release by tick (RELEASE_MASK=15, release=tick), the UCX-OS kernel without nested interrupts (isr=no_nesting), the crt0.s with the return test of _isr and the read back of _interrupt_set(0) (crt0=guard_readback) and the time-triggered injection of the packets between PEs (injection=tt; table app/weird_a_tt.h with t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v) of the image), costs=max_csv_static costs_file=weird_a.json) at F_CLK = 500000000 Hz, 20 ms of platform time, Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0, on the GAPH server, 2026-11-18 (experiments/REGENERATE.md, the command of run VG at the clock of this run: make -C experiments/exp23 sim software-without F_CLK=500000000 SIMDIR=build/sim-XG SW=build/sw-XG SIM_NS=20000000). Analysis with the join rule per_producer and the release rule tick; instrumentation from logs/XG.image.lst and logs/XG.noinstr.lst. Model of the run (the defaults of rttools): the network interface of each PE as a resource of the link schedule, o_i = L0 + 20 (m + 1) + w_NI (w_NI = 15169), and t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v)) of the costs file of RUN_INFO (experiments/wcet/costs/tt), the deadline of each packet at the release tick of its reader and the finish of each job with the handlers of the packet events of its PE (deadline=tick in RUN_INFO); tt: each packet against s_{i,j}, o_i and its deadline, each job end against F(v), each enqueue against s_{i,j}, each arrival against the start of its reader (rttools/paper/ttcheck.py). make check-run (or make LOG=logs/XG.events.txt REF=reference_VG.json OUTDIR=build/results_VG analyze check) Round r12: the image has the critical section around the queue of a task (lib/noc.c, every image of this tree); this run replaces run VG of round r11g.

tt.model: o_i = L0 + w_h (m + 1) + w_NI; tau = tick of the phase of the sending job
